Market today: The mood is cautious, with "Big Tech" lagging while other sectors show strength. The real driver for your names is still AI spending, but the broader market is diversifying.

Your holdings: SMCI (-20.03%), METU (-18.32%), MUU (-27.75%), SOXL (-55.03%), and SPAL (-36.46%) are all marked SELL and are leveraged ETFs, which amplify drops and decay over time. These need attention due to significant losses.

Watch: Oracle, Alphabet, and Amazon earnings are coming up, which could impact AI-related sentiment.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged, losing positions and watch for signs of sustained AI spending.
plays: Trim SOXL, SMCI, METU, MUU, SPAL. These leveraged ETFs are down significantly and decay over time.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
